classifications.question: May this WFA bucket redistribute third-party workflow code (or publish a pack/marketplace listing), or must every acquisition stay mechanism-only with no code carried across?
classifications.recommendation: Refuse redistribution and public listing. Record mechanisms only. Aligns with the catalog's claimed PR-ONLY release mode without treating that catalog row as an owner utterance.
classifications.default_if_unanswered: NO public publishing and NO third-party code redistribution. Mechanism-only records.
classifications.strongest_tradeoff: Mechanism-only drops some repair/fusion fidelity; redistribution creates a licence and publishing event the spec gates on the owner.

triggering_units.reason: Scheduler for every credentialed external acquisition call in this bucket; it is the spend/rate throttle, not a rotation tool.
triggering_units.question_or_target: Implementation target: a scheduler that serialises and jitter-staggers every credentialed external acquisition call made by the sweep lane and its retries, enforcing a per-provider token bucket read from config, so the bucket cannot produce a 429 thundering herd.

classifications.question: May the WFA acquisition lane incur new paid or unbounded external API spend, or must credentialed fetches stay inside already-provisioned free/existing quotas?
classifications.recommendation: Cap spend at already-provisioned credentials and published free-tier quotas. WFA-0029 must refuse a provider the moment the call would require a new paid account or uncapped bill.
classifications.default_if_unanswered: NO new paid spend and NO unbounded spend. Existing credentials only; skip a source rather than upgrade a plan.
classifications.strongest_tradeoff: A hard cap misses some marketplace/GitHub sources; an open cap is the unbounded-spend action the spec forbids without approval.

classifications.question: May any WFA terminal disposition (RETIRE, REJECT, further DELETE-ALL cleanup, decertification) delete candidate or worktree content, including unique user work found only in removed trees?
classifications.recommendation: Do not execute further terminal deletes until WFA-0076 has a live retrieval proof for that record. Salvage first (WFA-0015/0022/0064); default is retain.
